name: My Zypps - Ounce - Fruit Stand
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Fruit Stand ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Fruit Stand brings a fresh, fruit-forward profile: ripe mixed fruit and berry sweetness up front with a bright, juicy finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Fruit Stand flavor — ripe mixed fruit and berry with a juicy finish

My Zypps Fruit Stand is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
